userGroups.name: Business Analysts
userGroups.frequencyOfUse: Weekly to daily during active project planning phases
userGroups.experience: Low to medium technical proficiency; domain experts in GoA business processes with limited ADSP architectural knowledge
userGroups.accessibilityConsiderations: May require screen reader support and keyboard-only navigation; must meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA

userGroups.name: Developers
userGroups.frequencyOfUse: As needed when scoping new application features or planning ADSP integrations
userGroups.experience: High technical proficiency; familiar with REST APIs, TypeScript, and ADSP service documentation
userGroups.accessibilityConsiderations: Standard WCAG 2.1 Level AA requirements apply

userGroups.name: Tenant Administrators
userGroups.frequencyOfUse: Infrequently — primarily when adding, updating, or deactivating business pattern templates
userGroups.experience: Medium technical proficiency; familiar with TMW administrative interface and ADSP configuration concepts
userGroups.accessibilityConsiderations: Standard WCAG 2.1 Level AA requirements apply

tasks.name: Start a planning session
tasks.goal: Initiate a new PlanningSession to begin exploring an ADSP-based solution for a business problem

tasks.name: Describe business problem through conversation
tasks.goal: Engage with the Planning Agent to build a structured BusinessModel from natural language descriptions over multiple turns

tasks.name: Review and refine business model
tasks.goal: Review the Planning Agent's structured business concept extraction, correct misclassifications, and confirm accuracy before hypothesis generation

tasks.name: Review solution hypothesis
tasks.goal: Evaluate the proposed ADSP service composition presented in plain language with reasoning, and accept or request revision

tasks.name: Consult specialist agent
tasks.goal: Obtain deep technical guidance on a specific ADSP service (form, PDF, comment, notification) from the appropriate specialist agent

tasks.name: Resume interrupted session
tasks.goal: Reopen a paused planning session and continue from the last saved state without re-entering information

tasks.name: Manage business pattern library
tasks.goal: Create, update, or deactivate tenant-scoped business pattern templates to improve pattern matching accuracy

tasks.name: Export session plan
tasks.goal: Download a completed session plan as a structured document for sharing with stakeholders or storing in a project management tool

technicalEnvironment: Desktop browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) on government workstations
Government network with firewall restrictions on outbound connections
Tenant Management Webapp (TMW) as the host application shell
ADSP Platform with Keycloak SSO authentication
Node.js 22 + Express 5 backend on ADSP-provisioned infrastructure
physicalEnvironment: GoA government office environment or approved remote work location
Standard government workstation with widescreen display and keyboard/mouse
Stable internet connection to GoA network (VPN for remote workers)
